name: Securities Entry Type 2 Code
definition: Specifies the type of securities entry on an account.

BLOK.name: Blocked
BLOK.definition: Balance of securities that are blocked or frozen. A financial instrument may be unavailable due to external circumstances such as a court order, death of beneficiary or account owner, or bankruptcy.

ELIG.name: Eligible
ELIG.definition: Total number of securities eligible for this event.

PEND.name: Pending Delivery
PEND.definition: Balance of securities that are pending delivery.

PENR.name: Pending Receipt
PENR.definition: Balance of securities that are pending receipt.

NOMI.name: Registered
NOMI.definition: Balance of securities that are registered (in the name of a nominee or of the beneficial owner).

SETD.name: Settled
SETD.definition: Balance of securities representing only settled transactions.

BORR.name: Borrowed
BORR.definition: Balance of securities that have been borrowed from another party.

LOAN.name: On Loan
LOAN.definition: Balance of securities that have been loaned to a third party.

SPOS.name: Street Position
SPOS.definition: Balance of securities that remain registered in the name of the prior beneficial owner of securities.

TRAD.name: Traded
TRAD.definition: Balance of securities representing traded transactions.

COLI.name: Collateral In
COLI.definition: Balance of securities that belong to a third party and that are held for the purpose of collateralisation.

COLO.name: Collateral Out
COLO.definition: Balance of securities that belong to the safekeeping account indicated within this message, and are deposited with a third party for the purpose of collateralisation.

REGO.name: Out For Registration
REGO.definition: Balance of securities currently being processed by the institution responsible for registering the new beneficial owner (or nominee) of securities after a transaction has settled.
